about: Every number and rule this video shows or says, with its source. Twilio's docs page 'How long can a message be? | Twilio' (twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-sms-character-limit, modified 2026-09-16 per its meta tags) read on Oct 31, 2026 (Central) by a web-fetch agent; every 'confirms' line was quoted verbatim from that page that day. The plumber Sam and the example text are ours, not a real customer's words (EXAMPLE on screen).

twilio.title: How long can a message be? | Twilio
confirms: Table, SMS / GSM-7: Characters per one segment message 160; Characters per multi-segment message 153.
Table, SMS / UCS-2: Characters per one segment message 70; Characters per multi-segment message 67.
SMS splits messages longer than 160 characters into parts called segments, then are re-assembled when they received.
If your message includes a UCS-2 character like an emoji or a Chinese hanzi, SMS switches to the UCS-2 encoding.
Your text editor changes " to a curly or smart quotation mark. Your message includes a UCS-2 encoded character. This reduces the single message character limit from 160 to 70.
If the message exceeds 70 characters, it splits the message into two or more messages with 67 characters each.
Twilio bills SMS per message segment sent.
To avoid the cost of a second message segment, remove that UCS-2 character.
twilio.scope: SMS character limits and segment billing as Twilio documents them. Other texting apps built on SMS split the same way; their billing is their own (the video says Twilio bills per segment, nothing about other vendors' prices).

example.source: OURS: an example missed-call text, labeled EXAMPLE on screen; not a real shop or customer
example.text: Hi, this is Sam the plumber. Sorry I missed your call. What do you need fixed, and when works for you?
example.withEmojiNote: The 102-character text plus one emoji switches to UCS-2: over 70 characters, so it splits into 67-character segments, 2 of them (an emoji is 2 UTF-16 units); Twilio bills per segment. Every character of the plain text is in GSM-7's basic set (checked in code), so plain it is one segment.
example.usual: Thanks for calling, we value your business.
